verdict.rationale: Official SDKs are a fair question for an infrastructure-as-code tool, which could ship client libraries or a provider-development SDK, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents an official SDK. The cited material covers the CLI, the provider and module ecosystem counts, a nightly-build JSON feed, and a probe finding no OpenAPI spec. None of these is an official SDK for building against OpenTofu.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
